consumerRule: Fetch the authoritative snapshot for every hint; ignore duplicate/stale hints and only apply snapshots whose decimal-string revision compares greater by arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic.
reconnectRule: After reconnect, resubscribe and await the matching completion. On success, fetch and apply the authoritative snapshot before processing current hints. On RESOURCE_NOT_VISIBLE, stop watching and do not fetch a snapshot. On SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, do not treat the order as subscribed or fetch a snapshot; retry with bounded exponential backoff and jitter capped at 30 seconds.
